title: phlomis crinita subsp. composita
intro: Phlomis crinita subsp. composita, commonly known as Jerusalem sage, is a plant species within the Lamiaceae family, native to the Mediterranean region. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Phlomis crinita subsp. composita include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic effects, which contribute to its medicinal properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and diterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
